data.one_liner: Allows Dart reflection and method proxies using code generation across all platforms.
data.what_it_does: Enables reflection capabilities for local and third-party classes through code generation and bridge annotations. It also supports class proxies to intercept method calls and tools for JSON decoding into entities.
use_when: You need reflection features in Dart where native dart:mirrors is not supported.
You need to reflect on third-party classes using bridge annotations.
You want to create class proxies that intercept method calls.
avoid_when: You want to avoid code generation steps during development.
You do not need runtime reflection or dynamic method invocation.
strengths: Works across all Dart platforms where native mirrors are unavailable.
Supports third-party classes through reflection bridges.
Provides class proxies for intercepting method calls.
weaknesses: Requires maintaining a build_runner code generation step.
Requires proper part directives in files where reflection is enabled.
data.setup_notes: Add reflection_factory to dependencies and build_runner to dev_dependencies, then run dart run build_runner build.
